head: e86c5ca4d84252f8651482290791bcda3dd41a24

findings.summary: `.table td { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere }` lets a cell's min-content width shrink to about one character, and `.table table` still has max-width 100%, so a table wider than the page no longer scrolls sideways: columns shrink to header width and numbers break mid-value (25 numeric columns in an 800px page: cell 41px wide and 193px tall). `overflow-wrap: break-word` keeps min-content and scrolls.

notes: No pass was posted on e86c5ca itself (it merged during the review); earlier heads passed. The finding is the e86c5ca CSS change.
